note: 0.1.3 hook speed (cmd/hook.pl): the Stop hook's one budget, 3.5 s (under half its 8 s timeout), counts from the helper's start, before its libraries compile (main.pl). A helper that spent 3.4 s starting (STORE_TEST_HOOK_START_AGO_MS, as on a host slowed by load) gives reconcile no time for its sweeps and the watcher only its 0.2 s floor, so the hook ends itself well before Claude Code would cancel it; the turn's records are still written (last-stop) and reconcile and the watcher still run, each in what is left. With the 0.1.2 budget (7 s counted after the start) the same helper still gave the watcher its full 3 s
